title: Busy Is Not Crowded
request: Name the single wing that lent the most books this season. Deliver just the wing's name. A wing with a hundred titles nobody opened is not our busiest wing.
objective: Aggregate a numeric column by group instead of counting rows before ranking.
hints: Two wings can hold the same number of titles while one of them never leaves the building.
group with no second argument counts rows; group with sum adds the loans inside each wing.
Total the loans per wing, sort that total downward, and read the first entry of the wing column with item(0).
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
wings = ['Reference', 'Nature', 'Travel', 'Poetry', 'Mystery']
n = random.randint(5, 9)
chosen = [random.choice(wings) for _ in range(n)]
loans = random.sample(range(1, 90), n)
shelf = Table().with_columns('wing', make_array(*chosen), 'loans', make_array(*loans))
reference:
totals = shelf.select('wing', 'loans').group('wing', sum)
ranked = totals.sort('loans sum', descending=True)
deliver(ranked.column('wing').item(0))
